question: After I announce encore, can an opponent stop it by removing the card from my graveyard?

expected.shortAnswer: No: exiling the card is a cost, so no player can try to remove it from your graveyard to stop you.
expected.answer: Exiling the card with encore is a cost to activate the encore ability. Once you announce that you're activating it, no player may take actions until you've finished. They can't try to remove the card from your graveyard to stop you from paying the cost.
